annualized_metrics_note: Omitted: less than 90 days of common multi-timeframe history; annualization would be misleading.

signal_rules.parameters: EMA 9/21; SMA 20/50; RSI 14 (30/70); MACD 12/26/9; volume vs SMA20 with candle direction; ROC10; prior 20-bar ATR breakout; Supertrend ATR10 x3; Bollinger20 x2
signal_rules.per_timeframe: at least 3 same-direction indicator votes and >=60% agreement among non-neutral votes
signal_rules.global: at least 80% of four timeframe votes; because 3/4=75%, all four timeframes must align
signal_rules.execution: signal after candle close, entry at next 15m open; exit on opposite qualified signal; final close at last close
